question: Which of the following species has the same number of electrons as the potassium ion (K<sup>+</sup>)?
explanation: Potassium ion (K<sup>+</sup>) has 19 - 1 = 18 electrons. Argon (Ar) is a neutral atom with atomic number 18, thus is isoelectronic.
